purpose: Run one 2M-token screen of the stage-2b corrective weightings beside the two S47 matched controls on the S43 math-weighted stream, before any 20M corrective arm is trained, and apply the stage-2b v1 decision rule at 2M to decide which mechanism, if any, is worth the 20M budget. This is a screen, not the win bar: no win-condition threshold is moved, and a screen result cannot be quoted as the 20M win bar.

stage2b_v1.role: the win bar and the decision rule. Its four conditions and every threshold are used verbatim, applied at 2M; they are not edited

amendment_s47.role: registers `signed-true` as a distinct objective and makes the two 539,649-element matched controls mandatory comparison rows. This screen is the first run of both

s43_gate.role: the historical mechanism registration; its gate and active union are unchanged

s46_bounds.role: the measured reason the screen does not add a fourth weighting: the headroom is per-position, not per-class or per-feature-threshold, so the screen asks whether the existing objectives reach any of it, not whether a new cheap gate does

why_2m.argument: The bar receives a 20M budget because it is the distillation control, not because 20M is known to be needed. A weighting that cannot separate from its controls at 2M is not worth 9,765 steps, and the 2M rate is measured (2,316 and 2,354 tok/s for the two existing 2M arms), so five arms cost about 73 minutes of GPU. The 20M stage-2b arms remain registered and untouched.
why_2m.not_a_win: a 2M superiority is not the win bar. The bar's conditions are evaluated at 20M on all four anchored tasks; here only the two math tasks are scored and the knowledge family is not, so condition 4's knowledge clause is reported as not measured, not as satisfied
why_2m.screening_rule: the screen decides which arm, if any, is promoted to the registered 20M arms; it does not decide a mechanism claim

stream.why_identical: the same stream, teacher, objective weights and optimizer as the 20M arms and the bar, so a 2M screen is the same mechanism at a smaller budget, not a retune

common.optimizer: AdamW (fp32 moments; dense, at most 539,649 trainable parameters)
common.why: the S43/S44 registered 2M settings, unchanged, so each screen arm is comparable to memory-2m and adapter-2m at equal tokens

init.state_at_registration: not built; the build needs one GPU forward pass and runs after the 20M bar exits. Its SHA-256 is recorded in every corrective arm manifest
init.identity: the corrective gate is exactly zero at init, so every corrective arm starts bit-identical to base

corrective-signed-exp-2m-math.role: exp(clamp(A_t, -4, 4)) weight, the S43/S44 signed control at 2M

corrective-signed-true-2m-math.role: sigmoid(A_t / tau) plus the A_t < 0 token-loss protection term, the S47 objective at 2M

adapter-2m-math-matched.role: same stream, teacher and optimizer budget at the corrective arm's exact active union, with no memory and no gate: attributes a gain to the data

gated-dense-2m-math.gate: alpha_t = tanh(w . [h_t ; r_t] + b), w = b = 0 at init
gated-dense-2m-math.role: the same zero-initialised gate over a dense residual with no external memory: attributes a gain to the gate

accounting.components: 537,600 dense or memory elements + 2,049 gate elements
accounting.reference_rows: base = 0 added; adapter-2m = 537,600 added at 2M tokens (results/stage2/runs/adapter-2m)

heldout.metrics: mean next-token CE and mean KL(teacher_T || student_T) at T=2.0 over 3,906 non-overlapping 512-token chunks, paired per chunk against base
heldout.harm: the three corrected sign masks (teacher_better A_t > 0, base_better A_t < 0, tie A_t == 0) plus the lowest-advantage quartile, with token count, mean delta KL and fraction worse; taken from the training log's per-step objective diagnostics and reported as a training-stream measurement, not as held-out
heldout.gate_statistics: mean, mean |alpha|, min and max of the trained gate on the held-out chunks for the corrective and gated-dense arms; the training log's per-step gate summary for every arm that has a gate

anchored_math.sequence_correctness: the S47 block: the S45 exact final-answer verdict on the harness's own generations, reported beside the harness metric
anchored_math.why_two_tasks: the screen is about the math family. The knowledge family is not scored at 2M, so decision-rule condition 4's knowledge clause is reported as not measured rather than assumed satisfied
anchored_math.basis: all 1,319 GSM8K items and all 500 MATH-500 items, the same basis as the anchored table

decision_rule.source: docs/ws19-stage2b-corrective-advantage-preregistration-v1.json, decision_rule, applied at 2M with `adapter-2m` and `adapter-2m-math-matched` as the two comparison rows
conditions: 1. math family mean exceeds base by more than the combined independent standard error, and the paired per-item bootstrap interval on both math tasks excludes zero in the same direction
2. math family mean exceeds adapter-2m by more than the combined independent standard error, with the same paired requirement
3. held-out CE delta against base is not positive beyond its paired per-chunk standard error
4. no registered harm mask shows a positive mean delta KL on base_better tokens beyond its standard error; the knowledge clause is not measured at 2M and is reported as not measured
decision_rule.attribution: before any mechanism claim: an arm whose gain is matched by adapter-2m-math-matched is a data gain; one matched by gated-dense-2m-math is a gate gain

verdicts.corrective_arm_promoted: one corrective weighting satisfies all four measurable conditions and exceeds both matched controls: promote that weighting to the registered 20M arm
verdicts.data_gain: the matched dense adapter satisfies the same conditions and is not separated from the corrective arm: the screen result is the data, and 20M corrective training is not justified by it
verdicts.gate_gain: gated-dense-2m-math satisfies them and the corrective arm is not separated from it: the gate is the mechanism, not the external memory
verdicts.null: no arm beats base and adapter-2m on math: the corrective-residual family is not run at 20M on this route; the next route is the registered P19.9 utility routing, not another weighting
verdicts.ambiguous: the interval excludes zero but the sign is not consistent across the two math tasks, or the conclusion flips between the harness metric and sequence correctness: report both and promote nothing

sequencing.runs_after: the 20M bar exits and is scored. The screen is launched only after that receipt exists, so no second GPU job competes with the bar
sequencing.order: corrective-kl, corrective-signed-exp, corrective-signed-true, adapter-2m-math-matched, gated-dense-2m-math; one at a time
sequencing.each_run: train 2M, held-out receipt, anchored receipt, then the next arm

limits.host_memory: 6 GiB per arm: 2.0x the measured 2.95 GiB cgroup peak of the same student+teacher+memory shape (results/stage2/runs/memory-2m/receipt.json)
limits.refuse_when: the 20M bar is active, or host MemAvailable is below the limit plus 4 GiB

thresholds.statement: no win-bar condition, token budget at 20M, optimizer setting, seed or evaluation basis is changed. The 2M budget is the screen's, not the bar's; the registered 20M arms and their budget remain as registered

what_this_file_does_not_establish: that any weighting beats base or adapter-2m on math: that is the experiment
that a 2M separation survives to 20M: the screen is a gate on the 20M spend, not a scaling claim
that the knowledge family is unaffected: it is not measured at 2M

that the S46-gated mechanism is unnecessary in general: the bounds show no cheap one-threshold gate reaches the headroom on the selected sample, which is why this screen tests the existing objectives rather than a new cheap gate
